resource: Wikidata: NCBI taxonomy ID (P685) -> Open Tree of Life ID (P9157) of taxa (P31 Q16521)
query: PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/> PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/> PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#> PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#> SELECT ?ncbi_id ?ott_id WHERE { ?item wdt:P685 ?ncbi_id . OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P9157 ?ott_id } ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q16521 }
build: bin/fetch_wikidata_ott_table.py (the .gz holds the answer as it is: gzip -9, no name or time stamp)
bump: python bin/fetch_wikidata_ott_table.py data/; test the workflow with the new table; change WIKIDATA_OTT_TABLE in nf_workflow.nf; remove the old table and its json
